newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Taleban said to capture further Afghan province.
newsitem.headline: Taleban said to capture further Afghan province.

text.p: The Taleban Islamic militia captured the northern Afghan province of Samangan on Sunday from forces of opposition leader General Abdul Rashid Dostum, a Pakistan-based Afghan news service said.

The Afghan Islamic Press (AIP) quoted its sources in Afghanistan as saying the entire province had been captured by the Taleban after stiff resistance from Dostum's forces, which also lost the neighbouring province of Kunduz earlier on Sunday.
AIP said 11 Dostum soldiers were killed and more than 20 wounded in the Taleban attack.
It said more than 200 opposition soldiers were also captured by the Islamic miltia, while 150 others had surrendered.

Taleban and its newly allied Uzbek forces, who had mutinied against Dostum last week, had sent reinforcements to strengthen positions in Kunduz and help their troops fighting in nearby Baghlan province, AIP said.
